France Imposes Curfews Amid Widespread Unrest

France has extended curfews in some cities as authorities moved to quell widespread unrest. The Prime Minister announced new targeted curfews would be imposed where needed. The unrest has compounded fears of a debt crisis, with Paris-listed stocks, bonds, and the euro experiencing a fall. Former US President Donald Trump has commented on the situation, hailing Marine Le Pen as a 'conservative voice'. Meanwhile, Hungary and Poland have defended their tough migration policies in the context of the French disturbances.
